senses.gloss: (interch. with נָקַד; cmp. נָקָה) to be clean. [Sifra Aḥăré, Par. 9, ch. XIII שלא תִנְקוֹר ‘Rabad’, be not foppish in dress in order to attract the admiration of women; v., however, נָחַשׁ.]

units: <cite ref="Chullin 41b:5">Ḥull. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>הרוצה לנַקֵּר וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>לוַקֵּד</he>) he who wishes to keep his court clean.
